title: Crispy Pan-Fried Chicken Oysters (Sot-l'y-laisse)
ingredients: 8–10 chicken oysters (the two prized oval dark-meat medallions on the back of a whole chicken near the thigh socket), skin-on
1 tbsp unsalted butter + 1 tsp neutral oil
2 cloves garlic, lightly crushed in skin
Splash of dry white wine or fresh lemon juice
Flaky sea salt and freshly cracked black pepper
instructions: Pat the chicken oysters dry and season generously with salt and freshly ground black pepper.
Place skin-side down in a skillet over medium-high heat with 1 tsp oil and sear for 3–4 minutes until the skin is glass-crispy and golden.
Flip the chicken oysters, add butter, crushed garlic, and thyme sprigs, and baste with foaming brown butter for 90 seconds.
Finish with a squeeze of lemon juice or splash of white wine and serve immediately — known in French kitchens as 'sot-l'y-laisse' ('only a fool leaves them behind').
